conversation.Statement: Internal Revenue Service, this is Officer Daniels with the Refund Processing Division. Who am I speaking with?
Hi, this is Erica Stevens. I got a voicemail about a tax refund?

Yes, Ms. Stevens. Our records show you are owed a federal tax refund of $1,980, but due to new IRS verification protocols, there is a mandatory clearance fee. Have you received any prior notification from us about this?
No, this is the first I'm hearing about a clearance fee. Can't you just take it out of the refund?

Unfortunately, IRS guidelines require the fee to be paid up front for identity verification. If you do not complete this step by the end of today, your refund will be forfeited and reported as unclaimed income.
Wait, what? So if I don't pay today, I lose my refund?
That is correct. Additionally, unresolved verification may trigger a tax audit and possible penalties. I urge you to act immediately to avoid further legal action.
This is a lot. What exactly do I have to do?
First, I need to verify your identity. Please provide your full legal name, date of birth, and the last four digits of your Social Security number.
Okay... It's Erica Lynn Stevens, 08/22/1984, and the last four are 2234.

Thank you. Now, for the clearance fee of $299, you must make payment using electronic gift cards. The IRS only accepts Apple or Target gift cards for instant processing. Do you have either of those available now?
No, I don't. I'm at work and I'm picking up my son soon.

You must prioritize this process, Ms. Stevens. If you do not comply today, your refund is canceled, and additional fines will be assessed for noncompliance. Can you go to a nearby CVS or Walmart to purchase the cards right now?
I guess I can. I just don't have much time.
You cannot delay. Go to the store and purchase two Apple gift cards, each for $150. Once you have them, call this number back immediately and provide the codes from the back. Do you understand?
Yes, but why do I have to use gift cards? That doesn't seem right.

Do not question official IRS procedures, Ms. Stevens. If you refuse, your file will be marked as suspicious, and an arrest warrant could be issued for tax fraud by tomorrow morning. This is your final warning.
Please, I don't want any trouble. I'll get the cards after I pick up my son.
You must send the codes before 5 p.m. or the refund will be revoked and your account frozen by the Treasury Department. Do not delay.
